# F9: Numbers and names: never rounded quietly, odd numbers asked about, shared names told apart

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/finish/9-numbers-names.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured, and a limit its words don’t give is added after it, in the script’s test (“its test: …”).

## What it checks

numbers and names (backlog N, 8 Nov). No silent rounding (check-in, New goal), numbers far outside the plan asked about with their thousands grouped, the reason box in goal edit once the plan changes, a duplicate goal name warned about, and a shared person name allowed.

A width of 390 is a phone, 1440 (or 1280) a desktop; the address is in the demo on Thursday 5 November 2026 unless it names another day. {…} is a value the script works out as it runs.
